rules.hero_titles: Barlow Condensed ExtraBold, uppercase, tracking -1% to 1%
rules.numbers: Always use tabular-nums utility for data, tables, and sports numbers.
rules.restrictions: Do NOT use any other font families.

container.margins: 24px padding on sides for main container

dimensions.sidebar: 144px to 168px on desktop, collapsible under 1280px breakpoint

visual_enhancers.shadows: Light blue-black shadows. Avoid excessive glows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px gold or white at 20-35% opacity (e.g. border-white/20, border-gold-500/30).
visual_enhancers.focus_rings: Always visible on interactive elements: light blue or gold, must meet AA contrast.
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Editorial realistic photos must have a navy overlay (e.g., bg-navy-900/60 to bg-navy-900/80) to seamlessly integrate text and maintain legibility.

buttons.premium: Gold (#F4AE2B). Use strictly for high-relevance actions, marketing CTAs, or publishing. Hover: #D88913.
buttons.destructive: Red (#E54835) ONLY for errors, critical expirations, or destructive actions.

tables.density: High data density but readable, utilizing tabular-nums.

status_badges.pattern: Always combination of: Color + Icon + Text. E.g., Green dot/icon + 'Attivo'.

empty_loading_states.style: Cinematic and data-rich. Avoid generic spinners if possible; use skeleton loaders styled with navy-800. Empty states should feel like a sports dashboard waiting for data.

media.photography: Editorial realistic youth soccer, natural light or evening stadium lights. NO smiling posed stock photos.
media.logos: Generate SVG placeholders for club badges if real ones aren't available.

image_urls.description: Stadium evening lights, youth soccer match feel
Youth soccer action on pitch during day/evening

accessibility.focus: Focus ring always visible on keyboard navigation
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio against dark navy backgrounds. Use white-50 for primary text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in Italian.
Configure Tailwind CSS to use the exact specified colors and fonts. Do not deviate.
Build the application as a Hybrid Fullstack app (Sports League Management Platform + Public Sports Portal).
Implement the 'Hub Tornei' with tournament cards and an Active/Archive selector drawer.
Implement the 'Crea nuovo torneo' wizard (Start from scratch, Use template, Duplicate).
Implement the 'Control Room' overview with stat cards and fields grid.
Implement 'Impostazioni torneo' with tabs for categories, series, fields, slots, formula, scoring.
Implement the Public Portal: hero section, upcoming matches, mini standings, teams, tournament stats.
Implement 'Area Società' dashboard and 'Area Arbitro' mobile view.
Ensure the UI is completely dark-themed, cinematic, emotional, and data-rich.
DO NOT use a generic SaaS look. Follow the highly specific sports layout provided.
Make sure all interactive and key informational elements have a `data-testid` attribute.
No completely transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays that have content under them.

universal_guidelines.aesthetic: Avoid 'AI slop'. Create deep, layered interfaces with z-index hierarchy.
universal_guidelines.transitions: DO NOT use 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g. 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
universal_guidelines.alignment: Do NOT center align the app container. Respect natural reading flows.
universal_guidelines.icons: Use lucide-react for standard icons, but prefer @phosphor-icons/react or @heroicons/react for more specific sports/dashboard needs. NO emojis as icons.
